Consider the following statements about the unbounded feasible region of an LPP.

B. If $M$ is the smallest corner value of $Z=ax+by$, then $M$ is the minimum if the open half-plane $ax+by<M$ has no point common with the region.
C. An unbounded region has no corner points, so the corner point method cannot be used.
D. An unbounded region always gives the minimum at its corner point with the smallest $Z$.
